runo_hand_items_position.name: runo_hand_items_position
runo_hand_items_position.value: ("runo_hand_items"."state" = 'active' and "runo_hand_items"."position" between 1 and 3) or ("runo_hand_items"."state" = 'deferred' and "runo_hand_items"."position" is null)

runo_sessions_started_at.name: runo_sessions_started_at
runo_sessions_started_at.value: ("runo_sessions"."status" = 'running' and "runo_sessions"."started_at" is not null) or ("runo_sessions"."status" <> 'running' and "runo_sessions"."started_at" is null)

runo_tasks_window.name: runo_tasks_window
runo_tasks_window.value: ("runo_tasks"."window_start" is null and "runo_tasks"."window_end" is null) or ("runo_tasks"."window_start" is not null and "runo_tasks"."window_end" is not null and "runo_tasks"."window_start" < "runo_tasks"."window_end")

runo_tasks_fixed_time_window.name: runo_tasks_fixed_time_window
runo_tasks_fixed_time_window.value: "runo_tasks"."fixed_time" is null or "runo_tasks"."window_start" is null or ("runo_tasks"."fixed_time" >= "runo_tasks"."window_start" and "runo_tasks"."fixed_time" < "runo_tasks"."window_end")

runo_tasks_short_step.name: runo_tasks_short_step
runo_tasks_short_step.value: ("runo_tasks"."short_step_title" is null and "runo_tasks"."short_step_duration_min" is null) or ("runo_tasks"."short_step_title" is not null and "runo_tasks"."short_step_duration_min" is not null and "runo_tasks"."short_step_duration_min" > 0 and "runo_tasks"."short_step_duration_min" < "runo_tasks"."duration_min")
